written_by: Claude (3 sample pages opened per sage.com market; FR with three sage.com pages, ciel.com runs automatically)
summary:
Good news for DE: this morning's de-de publish (202611190912) changed load rule 274, so Floodlight 98 now fires for Sage Active web-shop trials and purchases again. The fix we proposed is live, and the DE part of the global web-shop incident is closed.
FR and ES web-shop purchases still do not fire Floodlight (129 / 36). That is now 2 markets, so it is no longer a global incident. It stays red as part of the pending EU web-shop set-up.
New red in DE: Microsoft UET still sends nothing on the Sage Active page. bat.js loads, but its event queue (window.uetq) is never processed, so no page view and no _uetmsclkid. The Intacct page uses its own UET tag (12002546) and works.
All four sage.com profiles were published this morning (09:12-09:38). The common change adds a Capterra tracking pixel (tr.capterra.com) and two rules for the en-my / en-sg profiles. Nothing else is conversion-relevant.
FR, ES and PT sample pages: consent works, nothing fires before consent, and Floodlight, Google Ads, GA4, LinkedIn, Meta and the click IDs (gclid, fbclid) are fine. PT is green.
Still open: AT form conversions cannot fire (GTM trigger needs a button ID), and www.ciel.com has no cookie banner.

brief.title: Working
items: Web-shop trials, purchases and all 136 lead forms fire Floodlight 98.
Consent, gclid and fbclid on all three sample pages; Intacct UET works (tag 12002546).

TAG:microsoft_uet|de-produkte-sage-activ.text: Re-checked with a 28 s wait: bat.bing.com/bat.js loads right after consent, but window.uetq stays a plain queue of 35 events, so the UET library never initialises and never sends a bat.bing.com/action hit. The page worked on 16 Nov. The Intacct page loads its own UET tag (bat.bing.com/p/action/12002546.js) and sends pageLoad with the msclkid, so UET itself works. The Sage Active / generic UET tag configuration is the likely cause.

CLID-02|de-produkte-sage-active.text: Same cause as the UET finding: without a UET hit the _uetmsclkid cookie is never written, so Microsoft Ads clicks cannot be matched to later conversions.

TAG:microsoft_uet|de-cp-payroll-standard.text: Same picture as Sage Active: bat.js loads, window.uetq stays a queue of 15 events, no hit. UET fires on most DE pages, so it is expected here too (market rule). Already on the list to clarify with MarTech.

CLID-02|de-cp-payroll-standard-shopping.text: Same cause as the UET finding on this page.

TEAL-04|market.text: de-de publish 202611190912: rule 274 (used by Floodlight 98) changed from 'ga4_customer_lead_type is set' to 'ga4_customer_lead_type OR customer_lead_type is set'. The web shop sends customer_lead_type, so tag 98 fires again for ecom_try and ecom_buy (replayed in the sandbox). Also new: tag 438 (Capterra pixel, tr.capterra.com) and rules 358/359 for the en-my / en-sg profiles. Low risk, fixes the August break.

CONV-03:ecom_try|market.text: Positive change: tag 98 fires again for web-shop trials. The baseline has been updated to expect tag 98.

CONV-03:ecom_buy|market.text: Positive change: tag 98 fires again for web-shop purchases. The baseline has been updated to expect tag 98.

FORM-02|form:HCM_2701_NCA_DE_HRReadyNCAB.text: The form's lastContentName starts with a space (' CL_HCM_DE_MED_CON_BOFU_HRReadyNCABeratung'). Load rule 331 checks the start of the name, so Floodlight 389 never fires for this form. Fix: remove the space in the Gated Content gate.

GTM-07|conversion:sage_012.text: GTM-PS6MXC v13 (unchanged): sageg0/sage_012 fires on gtm.click where Click ID contains 'Submit'. The submit inputs on /kontaktformular/ and /kostenloses-infopaket/ have no id, so the trigger never matches.
